AddressOperator.comment: An EOA used for "signature-less" in-game play

AddressOwner.comment: An EOA used to control an account and own externalized assets

Affinity.comment: The Affinity of an entity. For Kamis this is Eerie, Insect, Scrap and Mid.

BlockReveal.comment: blockhash that item is to be revealed at

CacheOperator.comment: @notice a bare component to cache an operator's account

DescriptionAlt.comment: A second description component. For use if needed

Description.comment: The Description of an entity, used to inform the FE

EntityType.comment: @notice a top level component that signals the type of shape an entity is. for registries.

Experience.comment: experience points of a kami or player

Harmony.comment: Harmony stat of a kami, equip or mod. Harmony is the defense against violence.

Health.comment: the health stat of an entity, composed of base, shift, mult, last (optional)

IDOwnsEquipment.comment: Maps equipment instance to its owner (kami)

IDOwnsInventory.comment: A reference to a Inventory entity's owner ID. Used to represent object ownership in the world

IDOwnsKami.comment: A reference to a Pet entity's owner ID. Used to represent object ownership in the world

IDOwnsQuest.comment: A reference to a Quest entity's owner ID. Used to represent object ownership in the world

IDOwnsRelationship.comment: A reference to a Relationship entity's owner ID. Used to represent object ownership in the world

IDType.comment: @notice reverse mapped types – usually a hashed value of (type, context)

IdHolder.comment: A reference to a Holder entity's ID. Used to represent object ownership in the world

IdSource.comment: the Source Entity of Something in a commit-reveal, it is the source of data. in a kill log, it is the killer

IdTarget.comment: world2: deprecate the Target Entity of something in a commit-reveal, it is the target of effect. in a kill log, it is the victim

Index.comment: generic index component for when another component (e.g. type) makes clear what the index should be referencing

IndexCurrency.comment: the item index of used on entities like listings and auctions where another Index determins

IndexFaction.comment: represents the human-set Node Index on a Node entity

IndexItem.comment: represents the autogenerated Item Index of a Registry entity

IndexKamiListing.comment: @notice Indexed kami token index for listing entities only.

IndexNode.comment: represents the human-set Node Index on a Node entity

IndexRelationship.comment: represents the human-set Relationship Index on a Registry entity

IndexRoom.comment: high level roomIndex of an entity (e.g. room number)

IndexSkill.comment: represents the autogenerated Skill Index of a Registry entity

IsRegistry.comment: identifies an entity as Registry entry

Level.comment: high level roomIndex of an entity (e.g. room number)

LogicType.comment: The LogicType of an entity, e.g. MIN, MAX

Power.comment: data harvesting power of a pet (in bytes/hr)

ProxyPermissionsERC721.comment: note: does not follow the typical ProxyComp flow to keep audited code frozen

Rarity.comment: higher raw number, the lower the rarity. imagine it as a % chance of being selected 0 values will never be chosen total rarity is the sum of all rarities in the pool

Rate.comment: the rate of something. precisions can be set arbitrarily within libraries

SkillPoint.comment: the number of skill points an entity has. on a Kami, this would be the number of skill points the kami has to spend on its skills. on a Skill, this would be the number of point allocated to the skill

Slots.comment: the number of base mod slots on a kami or equipment

Stamina.comment: the total stamina of an entity

State.comment: one day we will start using enums for state..

Subtype.comment: The Subtype of an entity. On Registries this is for taxonomization but the field can be extended to other use cases

Tax.comment: arbitrary value of a  thing , dependent on context

Time.comment: generalized timestamp component of when something occurred

TimeLastAction.comment: the timestamp of the last Standard Action taken Standard Actions are actions intentionally throttled by time or energy @dev no longer used for Kami (was used for cooldown), only accounts (stamina calcs)

TimeLast.comment: the timestamp of the last occurrence of an event/update

TimeNext.comment: @notice time based component @dev primarily used for cooldowns

TimeReset.comment: the timestamp of the last occurrence of an event/update

TimeStart.comment: the timestamp of the last action taken

TokenHolder.comment: @notice holds ERC20 tokens that have been deposited in game

Type.comment: The Type of an entity. On Registries this is for taxonomization but the field can be extended to other use cases

Value.comment: arbitrary value of a  thing , dependent on context

Violence.comment: Violence stat of a kami, equip or mod. Violence allows a kami to reap others at higher energy capacities.
